notes: Trusted screenshot over raw profile. Raw lists rgb(255,255,255) as dominant 'color' (498 borders + text on a dark page) — the true canvas is near-black ink (~#0e101a/#131419 sampled from hero/footer), so bg/fg were inverted to reflect the rendered page. 'muted' set to the rgb(79,91,95) body grey; large dormant index type is the lavender-alpha 'ghost' role, kept separate because it is a deliberate near-invisible state, not normal body. Durations/easings taken from the most frequent transitions (1.2s + .6s + .8s cinematic curves). Shadows negligible — single faint 1px present, no real elevation system.
